config.description: When a person adjusts a scheduled lamp's brightness or colour (app, dashboard, voice), records a lamp hold in sensor.ls_overrides so the engine leaves that lamp alone until a clearing rule ends the hold. Turning a lamp off, on or toggling it does NOT end its hold: the hold resumes when the lamp is switched back on. Holds end only through the end-override rules. Ignores calls with no user behind them (the engine, wake light, other automations). Also ignores light calls made inside a running script (same context as the script run), e.g. a person starting script.ls_apply by hand. Matching is per bulb, so a change through any grouping (e.g. light.kitchen_all, a single bulb, an area) holds every scheduled lamp it touches.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.event.context.user_id is not none and trigger.event.data.service == 'turn_on' and trigger.event.context.id not in (states.script | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | map(attribute='context') | map(attribute='id') | list) }}
